capabilities.description: Extract durable decision candidates from a bounded context snapshot.
capabilities.use_this_when: A save work order contains text that may include durable decisions or policies.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: The work order already supplies a validated memory_ticket.v1 payload.

capabilities.description: Shape extracted decisions into structured subject-predicate-object triples.
capabilities.use_this_when: A decision candidate needs a minimal structured vault shape.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: The candidate lacks a bounded source or should be rejected before shaping.

capabilities.description: Build a candidate vault node before admission and write.
capabilities.use_this_when: A structured save candidate must be checked before storage.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: The candidate is a raw transcript without durable intent.

capabilities.description: Reject nodes that do not meet the minimum admission contract.
capabilities.use_this_when: A candidate is about to be written.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: The candidate has already failed source_ref or memory_ticket validation.

capabilities.description: Write an admitted node to the local vault.
capabilities.use_this_when: The node has passed admission and write permission.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: Admission, source_ref, or permission evidence is absent.
capabilities.evidence_output: node id and written path hash

capabilities.description: Load the memory-ticket save manual from the managed capability catalog.
capabilities.use_this_when: A save request must prove what to store and why it is durable.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: The provider prompt already contains an unmanaged full manual.

capabilities.description: Decide whether a save candidate has enough source and intent evidence.
capabilities.use_this_when: A save candidate may be vague, raw, atomic, or missing provenance.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: The candidate has already been rejected by schema validation.

capabilities.description: Record task decomposition, selected action, observation, evaluation, and closure.
capabilities.use_this_when: A worker action loop needs auditable public progress evidence.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: The worker has no admitted work order.

capabilities.description: Summarize what was saved, rejected, or unavailable without leaking private paths.
capabilities.use_this_when: A save receipt needs a compact provider-safe summary.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: Storage evidence is absent and the result must be typed_unavailable.

capabilities.description: Explain why a save candidate could not be admitted or written.
capabilities.use_this_when: Storage evidence is weak or missing.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: A source-backed write already passed.

capabilities.description: Verify save evidence is more than delivery or pane text.
capabilities.use_this_when: A receipt may overclaim saved state.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: No save attempt occurred.

capabilities.description: Normalize MS receipt fields for selected capabilities, task ledger, permission, evidence, and evaluation.
capabilities.use_this_when: MS writes or rejects a save request.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: The result is not a Memory Saver receipt.

capabilities.description: Locate likely vault regions for a recall request.
capabilities.use_this_when: MF needs a bounded starting region for recall.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: A direct source_ref lookup is already supplied and resolved.

capabilities.description: Select a topic anchor from located regions.
capabilities.use_this_when: A recall request needs an anchor before reading claims.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: The anchor would be inferred without source support.

capabilities.description: Read origin claims for an anchored topic.
capabilities.use_this_when: MF must recover why a memory exists.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: The source ref is unresolved.

capabilities.description: Read recent claims for currentness and near-miss comparison.
capabilities.use_this_when: MF must check whether a memory is current.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: The memory lifecycle is stale or superseded without active support.

capabilities.description: Collect claim ids for support bundle assembly.
capabilities.use_this_when: MF has candidate claims that need source path verification.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: No aligned candidates exist.

capabilities.description: Read source paths for selected claims.
capabilities.use_this_when: MF needs support paths before answering.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: The candidate is a near-miss or stale route.

capabilities.description: Assemble support_bundle.v1 from aligned facts and source paths.
capabilities.use_this_when: MF has source-backed aligned candidates.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: Source paths or query alignment are missing.

capabilities.description: Assemble a degraded support candidate when the pathfinder exits before a durable topic anchor is selected.
capabilities.use_this_when: MF has read-only candidate material but no fully anchored topic route yet.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: The result would be treated as full support_bundle PASS without source paths and query alignment.
capabilities.evidence_output: degraded pathfinder bundle or typed_unavailable reason

capabilities.description: Discover the managed recall manual without loading the full skill universe.
capabilities.use_this_when: A recall request needs worker manual selection evidence.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: The Provider prompt already contains a raw unmanaged manual.

capabilities.description: Decide whether recall support can be exposed to the Provider.
capabilities.use_this_when: MF has selected candidates but must check evidence and privacy boundaries.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: No candidates were generated.

capabilities.description: Prevent private source details from leaking into provider-visible surfaces.
capabilities.use_this_when: MF prepares a support bundle for Provider reflection.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: The output is private proof only.

capabilities.description: Summarize recalled memory without raw transcript replay.
capabilities.use_this_when: MF has aligned source-backed support.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: The support is weak or unrelated.

capabilities.description: Explain missing, weak, stale, or near-miss recall support.
capabilities.use_this_when: Recall support is weak or absent.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: Aligned source-backed support exists.

capabilities.description: Propose a bounded retry query when support is weak.
capabilities.use_this_when: The first recall pass is weak or near-miss.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: Retry budget is exhausted or support is present.

capabilities.description: Compare initial and retry candidates before answering or typed_unavailable.
capabilities.use_this_when: A retry has been attempted.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: No retry evidence exists.

capabilities.description: Verify recalled support is source-backed and query-aligned.
capabilities.use_this_when: MF is about to return support to Provider.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: Source paths or alignment are absent.

capabilities.description: Normalize MF support or unavailable receipt sections.
capabilities.use_this_when: MF returns support_bundle.v1 or typed_unavailable.v1.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: The result is not a Memory Finder receipt.

capabilities.description: Build deterministic reranking features for each retrieval candidate.
capabilities.use_this_when: Candidate generators produce multiple possible routes.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: There are no candidates.

capabilities.description: Rerank candidates using structural features and hard gates.
capabilities.use_this_when: MF must select or reject candidate support routes.
capabilities.do_not_use_this_when: A direct source_ref lookup has already failed hard gates.
